records.title: Embedding Self-Correction as an Inherent Ability in Large Language Models for Enhanced Mathematical Reasoning
records.reason: 本文のCoSCは数学LLMのself-correctionをfine-tuningで教え、multi-round inferenceでaccuracyを高める。ZeRO-Infinity training-memory系統との技術的接続や推論コスト削減は確認されず、反復修正は追加推論を要するため対象外。

records.title: Speech-Mamba: Long-Context Speech Recognition with Selective State Spaces Models
records.reason: 本文のSpeech-MambaはTransformerとselective SSMを組み合わせ長い音声列を扱い、near-linear sequence scalingを狙う。Jamba系統に使うMamba/long-context architectureとの接点はあるが対象はspeech recognitionで、LLM servingの性能測定はないためborderline。
